Drones. AI. Cloud software. Sustainable future. We have all the buzzwords.

We're on a mission to make the most vital infrastructure — like power plants and oil & gas facilities — safer, greener, and more reliable.

Will you help perfect it?

Your ideas, your impact.

Here, titles don't matter—what you bring to the table does. We're all about letting the best ideas shine, no matter where they come from. If you've got a vision, you'll have the chance to see it through from start to finish. Your ideas won't just be heard; they'll be built (by YOU).

Hardware, software, and everything else.

Our tech is cool—there's no other way to put it. We're working with the latest in robotics, AI, and more, to build systems that actually make a difference. Whether you're passionate about hardware, software, or anything in between, you'll find a place here to push boundaries and create something that matters.

Leading innovation

We are proud to be a leading innovator in the field and are always looking for top performers to join us in our mission to transform the industry and empower the autonomous future. Our current openings are below. If you don't see a position that's right for you, but think you are a fit as part of our forward-thinking team, you are welcome to submit your resume for future consideration.

Please email resumes to jobs@percepto.co and indicate the job title in the subject line.

Current Openings:

All legitimate recruiting messages from Percepto will ONLY come from an @percepto.co email address. Percepto will never ask candidates for money, gift cards, or other “proofs of loyalty.” If you receive any suspicious outreach – please report it immediately to info@percepto.co.
